newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SM Prime says to open two new malls in 97.
newsitem.headline: SM Prime says to open two new malls in 97.

text.p: SM Prime Holdings Inc said on Monday it is planning to open two more malls this year which will add another 220,000 square metres of gross floor area of mall spaces to its inventory.
The company said a shopping mall in Cavite, just south of Manila, will be opened sometime in June or July, while another one in Fairview, east of Manila, will be opened in October this year.
At present, the company owns 940,000 square metres of gross floor area of mall space.
